title: A Fine-Grained Empirical Study of Upstream Security Events and Downstream Mitigation in Maven
abstract: arXiv:2610.36603v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Open-source vulnerability mitigation spans upstream libraries and the downstream projects that depend on them. Upstream, a vulnerability progresses through a public report when one exists, a fix, a fixed release, and NVD disclosure. Downstream, a project mitigates it by adopting the fixed release, and the timeliness of this adoption is measured relative to these events. Prior work studies the two sides separately, so it is unclear whether downstream exposure stems from delayed upstream release, delayed downstream adoption, or both. We address this gap by following 832 CVEs in the Maven ecosystem from the upstream fix to its adoption by each exposed downstream project. We classify upstream fixes as \textit{silent} or \textit{transparent}, recover the order of report, fix, release, and NVD disclosure, and link vulnerable artifacts to their downstream dependents. translated_title: Maven生态中上游安全事件与下游漏洞缓解的细粒度实证研究
translated_abstract: 开源漏洞缓解涉及上游库以及依赖这些库的下游项目。在上游，漏洞会经历如下过程：发布公开报告（如果存在）、进行修复、发布修复版本以及NVD披露。在下游，项目通过采用修复版本来缓解漏洞，而这种采用的及时性是相对于上述事件来衡量的。以往的研究将这两方面分开研究，因此尚不清楚下游的安全暴露究竟源于上游发布延迟、下游采用延迟，还是两者兼有。我们通过追踪Maven生态系统中832个CVE从上游修复到每个受影响下游项目采用的全过程来填补这一研究空白。我们将上游修复分类为“静默式”或“透明式”，还原了报告、修复、版本发布和NVD披露的先后顺序，并将存在漏洞的构件与其下游依赖者相关联。随后，我们将这一时间顺序与下游的采用情况以及dependabot的使用情况进行对比分析。
tldr: 该研究首次对Maven生态系统中832个CVE进行从上游修复到下游采用的端到端细粒度追踪，揭示了下游安全暴露究竟源于上游发布延迟、下游采用延迟还是两者兼有的问题。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first fine-grained end-to-end tracking of 832 CVEs in the Maven ecosystem from upstream fixes to downstream adoption, revealing whether downstream security exposure stems from delayed upstream releases, delayed downstream adoption, or both.
